High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for Commander Vanden Willard, a fan re-set (not a Players Committee or Decipher publication) with the Decipher errata text of [[Commander Vanden Willard (Decipher Errata 1998)]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Light_E/Commander Vanden Willard _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1EmE_3Od-3GXwMwqN_6-81m10C8BJXiGq/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Commander Vanden Willard _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,800 bytes, SHA-256 <code>73ab71404e9ac01c1bd3ec82e1eed0dc7e74337fe94e3cad8e5776ea64f8f6c4</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 46.0, 47.5, 74.0, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

It is listed in the card's versions list as “strangewayes print (fan re-set, not a PC or Decipher publication)”; it is not shown on the Decipher Errata or Players Committee version pages.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project. Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.. It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
